# Support

Winora is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Read the release limits first

[Release limits](../technical-docs/release-limits.md) explains what Winora 0.x does and does not do, what SmartScreen will say, where Winora keeps its data and what happens when you uninstall it. There is no user guide website yet.

## Ask a question

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=question.yml). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first. Someone may have asked already.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include your Winora version, your Windows build and the steps to repeat the problem. In Winora, **Settings > Export diagnostics** saves an archive you can attach. Personal data is removed from it, but read it before you attach it. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs-well) explains what makes a good report.

## A change did not work or cannot be undone

Open the **History** page first. It shows the result of every change, and the reason when a change or an undo did not go through. Some settings only take effect after you sign out, and Winora tells you so. Quote the result text in your bug report.

## Request a new Windows setting

Use the [setting request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=setting_request.yml). A link to an official source (for example Microsoft Learn) is required, because every setting in Winora is based on one.

## Request a feature

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describe the problem first. Winora stays offline and changes only reviewed items, so some ideas will not fit.

## Fix a translation

Use the [translation fix form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=translation_fix.yml), or send a pull request. See [Translations](CONTRIBUTING.md#translations).

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/security/advisories/new) and read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Please never post

Your user name, computer name, product keys, serial numbers, network addresses or file paths with your name in them. None of them are needed to fix a problem, and issues are public.

## What to expect

- Help is given by a volunteer in spare time. Replies are best effort, and there is no guaranteed response time.
- There is no phone, email or chat support.
- Only the latest release is supported. Please update before you report a bug.
- Please be kind. The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies in every issue and pull request.

If you want to support the project, you can [support the project](https://enaloo.com/support/). It is not expected, and it does not change how issues are handled.

If you want to help others, answering a question in an issue is a good way to contribute. Developers can run the tests with `dotnet test Winora.slnx`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#checks).
